verdict.rationale: Three.js is fundamentally a WebGL/WebGPU browser-based rendering library, and headless/CI execution (e.g., via headless-gl, node-canvas, or Puppeteer) is a plausible and real use case for such an engine, so the axis applies. However, none of the evidence mentions headless rendering, Node.js compatibility, CI pipelines, or automated testing setups — all examples and docs reference browser contexts (WebGLRenderer, DOM, import maps, devtools extension).
